summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by Akzo Nobel N.V. reporting that its Russian subsidiaries have been placed under temporary external administration by a presidential decree in Russia. Operational oversight is transferred to an external entity while ownership remains unchanged. Russia represents less than 2% of AkzoNobel's revenue and is not material to financial performance. The company is reviewing the decree and remains committed to supporting employees and safeguarding interests. This is a regulatory disclosure, has not been solicited by any party, and the filing does not involve a transaction or special situation like an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring.
